title: Market experience and the gap
hook: Two stated cases: explore a procedural contrast rather than a universal endowment claim.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How a procedural contrast rather than a universal endowment claim affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Ratio, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare a procedural contrast rather than a universal endowment claim in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: A toy seller asks 6; a buyer offers 3 for the same item. What is the sell-to-buy ratio?
